# Ben Stanley

> Associate Professor in the Faculty of Social Sciences, SWPS University. Research on populism, illiberalism and authoritarianism in Central and Eastern Europe.

## Pages

- [Ben Stanley](https://benstanley.eu/)
- [Citation reach](https://benstanley.eu/pages/citation-reach.html): Updated:
- [Good Change](https://benstanley.eu/pages/good-change.html)
- [Media reach](https://benstanley.eu/pages/media-reach.html): Updated:
- [Media](https://benstanley.eu/pages/media.html)
- [Policy reach](https://benstanley.eu/pages/policy-reach.html): Updated:
- [Polish political analyses](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses.html): Interactive analyses of Polish politics: parties, elections and public opinion
- [Constituencies](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/constituencies.html): The Constituencies page is now the Geography page of the Polling tracker
- [Constitutional Tribunal](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/constitutional-tribunal.html): Who has sat on Poland's Constitutional Tribunal since 1985 and how they were chosen, what it has ruled since 1997, how its work has changed, and the disputes about it since 2015
- [Poland's 2027 parliamentary election](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/election-2027.html): Updates on the 2027 Sejm election: what the polls say, what they would mean for seats and government, and when and how the election is held
- [Timing and organisation](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/election-2027/organisation.html): When the 2027 election to the Sejm and Senate can be held, who calls and runs it, and the rules that turn votes into seats, with the legal basis of each
- [Election results](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/election-results.html): Every presidential, Sejm, Senate, European Parliament and referendum vote in Poland since 1990: facts, results and maps of every gmina and constituency, and the careers of senators and MEPs
- [Governments](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/governments.html): Who sat in each of Poland's 23 cabinets since 1988: ministers, reshuffles, ministries and their changes, and the party, age and gender of those who held them
- [Legislative activity](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/legislative-activity.html): How the Sejm, the Senate and the European Parliament vote: club and group cohesion, every member's record, and, for the Sejm, positions in the roll calls, how late ministries answer and the topics of the laws passed
- [Parties in the Sejm](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/party-genealogy.html): Polish parties in the Sejm since 1989: their genealogy, the seat strength of each party and party family day by day, and MPs' defections between clubs
- [Party ideology](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/party-ideology.html): Where Polish parties stand in European ideological space, from the Chapel Hill Expert Survey and The PopuList, and how they compare with their own voters
- [Party manifestos](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/party-manifestos.html): What Polish parties stressed in their Sejm election manifestos from 1991 to 2019, from the Manifesto Project's coding of each manifesto
- [Party system indicators](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/party-system-indicators.html): Fragmentation, disproportionality, volatility, nationalisation, polarisation and government closure in the Polish party system, 1991 to the current polls
- [Social and political trends](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/political-attitudes.html): Long-run trends in Polish society and public opinion since 1990, pooled from many surveys, from left–right self-placement and support for EU membership to trust in institutions, religion and living conditions, with breakdowns by party, age, gender, education and place of residence
- [Polling tracker](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/polling-tracker.html): A Bayesian poll-of-polls for elections to the Polish Sejm: voting intention since 2023, by group and by pollster, with every Sejm term since 1991
- [Polling tracker: Geography](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/polling-tracker/geography.html): Where the seats would fall this week, constituency by constituency, and what a vote is worth in each Sejm constituency, 1991–2023: electors, votes and residents per seat, what a list needs for a seat, and a profile of each constituency
- [Polling tracker: Scenarios](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/polling-tracker/scenarios.html): Change vote shares, put parties on joint lists, or shift turnout and support in any group of voters, and see what follows for the seats and the options for government, with the model's uncertainty
- [Polling tracker: Seats](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/polling-tracker/seats.html): What the polls would mean for the Sejm this week: seats with their ranges, the chance of each majority, and every one of the 460 seats with each list's chance of holding it
- [Presidents](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/presidents.html): Poland's presidents since 1989: their parties, Chancellery and governments, and how they used their powers — vetoes, bills, applications to the Constitutional Tribunal, appointments and pardons — compared across presidencies
- [Quality of democracy](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/quality-of-democracy.html): Polish democracy since 1990 in the V-Dem project's expert ratings, against Central and Eastern and Western Europe, with polarisation in V-Dem and in the Sejm's roll calls
- [Voting behaviour](https://benstanley.eu/pages/polish-political-analyses/voting-behaviour.html): Who votes for whom in Poland's Sejm elections, 1997–2023, and who stays at home, by age, gender, education, residence, religious attendance and socio-economic position, with a calculator for a hypothetical voter
- [Pooling the Poles](https://benstanley.eu/pages/pooling-the-poles.html): Pooling the Poles is now the Polling tracker under Polish political analyses
- [Publications](https://benstanley.eu/pages/publications.html): Updated:

- [Podstawy dziennikarstwa danych](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/podstawy-dziennikarstwa.html)
- [The Social Psychology of Democracies in Transition](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/social-psychology-democracies.html)
- [Introduction to Social Research Methodology](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/social-research-methodology.html)
- [Systemy polityczne](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/systemy-polityczne.html)
- [Unia Europejska i jej instytucje](https://benstanley.eu/pages/teaching/unia-europejska.html)
